variables.name: mDisconnectTime
variables.comment:
* These time/timespan values are based on System.currentTimeMillis(),
     * i.e., "wall clock" time.

variables.name: mConferenceConnectTime
variables.comment: The cached connect time of the connection when it turns into a conference.

variables.name: mDtmfToneDelay
variables.comment: The cached delay to be used between DTMF tones fetched from carrier config.

variables.name: mShouldIgnoreVideoStateChanges
variables.comment:
* Used to indicate that video state changes detected by
     * {@link #updateMediaCapabilities(ImsCall)} should be ignored.  When a video state change from
     * unpaused to paused occurs, we set this flag and then update the existing video state when
     * new {@link #onReceiveSessionModifyResponse(int, VideoProfile, VideoProfile)} callbacks come
     * in.  When the video un-pauses we continue receiving the video state updates.

variables.name: mIsRttEnabledForCall
variables.comment: This reflects the RTT status as reported to us by the IMS stack via the media profile.

variables.name: mIsMergeInProcess
variables.comment: * Used to indicate that this call is in the midst of being merged into a conference.

variables.name: mIsLocalVideoCapable
variables.comment:
* Used as an override to determine whether video is locally available for this call.
     * This allows video availability to be overridden in the case that the modem says video is
     * currently available, but mobile data is off and the carrier is metering data for video
     * calls.

variables.name: mImsReasonInfo
variables.comment:
* When the call is in a disconnected, state, will be set to the {@link ImsReasonInfo}
     * associated with the disconnection, if known.

variables.name: mIsHeldByRemote
variables.comment: * Used to indicate that this call is held by remote party.

variables.name: mIsBusinessComposerFeatureEnabled
variables.comment: * Used to indicate if both the user and carrier config have enabled the business composer.
